decks.name: LeetCode #124 - Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
decks.description: Find maximum path sum in binary tree where path can start and end at any node

cards.question: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum: A path in a binary tree is a sequence of nodes where each pair of adjacent nodes in the sequence has an edge connecting them. A node can only appear in the sequence at most once. Note that the path does not need to pass through the root. The path sum of a path is the sum of the node's values in the path. Given the root of a binary tree, return the maximum path sum of any non-empty path.

solutions.name: Depth First Search
solutions.explanation: Use two separate DFS functions: main dfs traverses all nodes, helper getMax computes max path from a node to any leaf. For each node visited by dfs, call getMax on left and right children to get max paths, then update global result with sum of node value plus both paths. Continue traversing to all nodes. Inefficient because getMax is called repeatedly for same subtrees. O(n²) time due to redundant calculations.

solutions.timeDescription: Quadratic time because getMax is called for each node during traversal, and getMax itself traverses entire subtrees, leading to redundant calculations
solutions.spaceDescription: Recursion stack depth proportional to tree height, O(h) typically, O(n) worst case for skewed tree
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Given tree [-10,9,20,null,null,15,7]: dfs(-10): getMax(9)=9, getMax(20)=35, res=max(-inf, -10+9+35)=34. dfs(9): getMax(null)=0, getMax(null)=0, res=max(34, 9+0+0)=34. dfs(20): getMax(15)=15, getMax(7)=7, res=max(34, 20+15+7)=42. Return 42. Note: getMax recalculates subtree sums multiple times.

solutions.name: Depth First Search (Optimal)
solutions.explanation: Single optimized DFS function that simultaneously computes max path from each node upward AND updates global maximum. For each node, recursively get leftMax and rightMax from children, clamp negative values to 0 (ignore negative contributions). Update global result with path through current node (node.val + leftMax + rightMax). Return upward path (node.val + max(leftMax, rightMax)) for parent's calculation. Each node visited once. O(n) time and space.
